item.title: Riley Leonard turns patience into success
item.description: Former Notre Dame quarterback Riley Leonard was golfing with his brothers when his phone rang. item.title: The Not-So-Royal Shakespeare Company's 'Unrehearsed' was entertaining chaos
item.description: On Feb. 13, the Not-So-Royal Shakespeare Company (NSR) gave a one-night-only performance of "The Taming of the Shrew" live on the Haggerty Family Stage in the Duncan Student Center. But this wasn't a typical performance of the Bard's work, for it featured a major twist: none of the actors had ever encountered the material nor knew the story going into it.
